guide.title: Your first feeder
guide.1: Place a grid supply, a circuit breaker and a load from the component list.
guide.2: Choose Wire, then click the output of one component and the input of the next.
guide.3: The calculation runs by itself. Check the voltage at the load and the Problems list.
guide.note: Nothing you do here deletes your work.
